message.content: It depends on who you ask, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Nomadland”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Chloé Zhao, it went on to win the Academy Award for Best Picture (and Best Director) in 2021, cementing its place as one of the year's most celebrated releases. Other strong contenders that year included “The Trial of the Chicago 7,” “Promising Young Woman,” and “Soul.”
